Also, when scaling certain characters above a certain level, it's vital to acknowledge how the DC cosmology functions, which substantiates placements and their transcendence over succeeding planes of existence. Realms like Limbo and Monitor Sphere are both High Outerversal realms as they act on a hierarchy of fictional transcendence over the below realms. Limbo views realms like the Sphere of the Gods and below as nonexistent fiction and transcends its infinite hierarchies such as infinite Heavens, Hells and Limbos. Monitor Sphere views realms like Limbo as minuscule and infinitesimal, where everything is more profound and meaningful. The Monitor Sphere is also a world of primal and more fundamental Platonic Forms, which would mean that the Sphere of Gods, which is already a Platonic Archetypal realm, "participates" in the Monitor Sphere. The cosmology functions on higher fictional transcendences over each realm, so that's where the scaling is derived from. Use these links as references. It's also important to understand that the tier placement for John Constantine is situational, and he doesn't always exert this level of power. The justification for the tier placement is his ability to consistently contend with higher-dimensional beings that correlate with the logic of the cosmology as I established previously. John Constantine scales off of certain high-level magic users like Doctor Fate, Zatanna and Spectre, as well as scaling above other beings that normally contest or scale above Outerversal levels of powers. Constantine's power and the spells he casts also play a major factor in determining his overall power, as it is mainly situational. Constantine's power and the spells he casts also play a major factor in determining his overall power, as it is mainly situational. As better detailed in his Social Influencing section in Powers & Abilities, John Constantine is known as the World's Greatest Con Man for a reason, with him having shown the ability to adapt his incredible talking and planning skills to basically any situation, to the point that one could say that despite his wealth of magical knowledge, John's best weapon is his cunning. Standard Tactics: Constantine is typically not a fighter. If possible, he will retreat from a fight to find help or a better strategy. If that is impossible, he is a dirty fighter, sometimes completely forgoing flashy magic spells for more subtle and sneaky tactics if it fits the situation. Other times, he will seek to end the fight as quickly as possible, resorting to techniques that ignore durability in favor of incapacitating or even killing the enemy in some other way.

Suffers from lung cancer now that his Demon Blood has been removed. In his base, he possesses Normal Human Weaknesses, has cancer, and in all of his forms is extremely egotistical. The Lexo-suit can seemingly be disabled with an electric shock to the back. Otherwise, none notable. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Apex Predator Physiology: As a fusion of the Human and Martian races, The Apex Predators live and fight forever and they retain all Martian abilities, such as the ability to control their physical down to molecular level, allowing them to shift their sizes, change their body parts and mimic other appearances. 9-A physically, far higher with Weaponry and Preparation | At least 9-A physically, far higher with Weaponry and Preparation | High 5-A | High 5-A, possibly higher | High 5-A, possibly higher

Base: * Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Lifting Strength, and Durability) * Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) * Preparation (Prepared traps for Kryptonians and AMAZO, and built a nanotech disruptor weapon to dismantle AMAZO during "The Return." Prepared missiles to destroy Brainiac. Made a plan to get Superman into the vicinity of Kryptonite in order to defeat him. Installed overrides into dozens of members of the Legion of Doom to make sure their powers would be ineffective against him. Built a Kryptonite-infused nuclear warhead to kill Superman, as depicted in “Legacy.” Prepared a getaway vehicle with missiles while confronting the League. Built the Energy Disruptor to de-power the Justice League. Often provides his associates with weapons) * Social Influencing (Charisma and Deception: Is an almost peerlessly shrewd businessman known for his ability to charm and influence others. Easily manipulated AMAZO during “Tabula Rasa,” and during "The Return," when AMAZO despised him, Lex was still so compelling that he could talk AMAZO out of killing him. Convinced several members of the Legion of Doom (including Sinestro, who holds basically no loyalty to anyone) to join him instead of Grodd) * Archery Skill (Hit a bullseye from a distance) If given preparation time, Lex can utilize: * Energy Projection (With his energy pistol, his military drones, etc) * Situational Durability Negation and Statistics Reduction (with Kryptonite, which has these effects on Kryptonians such as Superman) * Hacking (Hacked the JL Watchtower to make it fire the fusion cannon) * Flight (with several vehicles such as the Lex-wing, his helicopter, and the police battlesuit) * Statistics Amplification and Mind Manipulation (Given time, he made dozens of members of the Legion of Doom more powerful and re-wired Bizarro’s brain to make him totally loyal to him. Built a mind control device for Grodd) * Explosion Manipulation (Prepared missiles to destroy Brainiac. The Lexo-skel and Police Battlesuit both have grenade launchers. Built a bomb to blow up the JL Watchtower. Planted bombs beneath his cloning lab) * Fire Manipulation (His mech could shoot fireballs) * Light Manipulation (The police battlesuit fires Blacklight Lasers) * Homing Attack (The Lexwing fires homing missiles) * Electricity Manipulation (With these gauntlets. His crony used a taser powerful enough to knock out Bizarro. The Lexo-skel can also electrify its exterior) * Power Nullification (with the Energy Disruptor, which depowered the Justice Lords) * Large Size (Many of his robots possess this) * Attack Reflection against Magic (with this artifact) * Resistance to and Reversal of Mind Manipulation (Turned Grodd's mind manipulation back onto him), as well as Negation/Reversal of Metal Manipulation (Created a contingency to override and reverse Dr. Polaris' ferrokinesis) Slightly Brainiac Enhanced: All previous abilities, as well as: * A greater degree of Superhuman Physical Characteristics * Limited Biological Manipulation (Brainiac's influence within his body cured his cancer and increased his strength) * Resistance to Extreme Heat (His hand was completely unaffected by containing the fiery explosion of an explosive Batarang) Lexo-suit: All previous non-preparation-based abilities, as well as: * Energy Projection (with this beam) * Electricity Manipulation (Electrocuted Wonder Woman upon contact) * Flight (Can freely fly through the air) Fused with Brainiac (Pre-Dark Heart Absorption): All previous non-preparation based abilities, as well as: * Explosion Manipulation (Caused this huge explosion) * Regeneration (Mid-Low: Healed from being shot repeatedly) * Additional Limbs (with his tentacles) * Multiple Selves (Brainiac also inhabits his body) * Paralysis Inducement (with his tentacles) * Matter Manipulation (Turned the Lexcorp building into a ship) * Resistance to Extreme Heat (Brainiac's prior enhancements gave him this) Fused with Brainiac (Post-Dark Heart Absorption): All previous abilities, as well as: * Energy Projection (with this beam) * Creation (Via his Matter Manipulation - Created a shotgun) * Resistance to Extreme Heat (Brainiac's prior enhancements gave him this) * As well as presumably all of Brainiac's abilities due to their complete fusion

Small Building Level physically (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - While certainly weaker to some extent, hurt Batman with a headbutt and punch, though he didn't succeed in doing much but momentarily staggering the Dark Knight. Smashed machinery with his bare hands), far higher with weaponry and preparation (Built a mech that oneshot Hawkgirl and defeated Green Lantern. Though seemingly weaker, the Lexcorp police battlesuit seems to have kept up with and slightly harmed Superman. Prepared a 6.5 megaton payload of missiles to destroy Brainiac. Put a half kiloton of explosives under his cloning lab. The Lexo-Skel could blow up a tank in one shot and nuke a building with its grenades. His mechanical dinosaur should be at least Small Building Level due to sheer size and (presumable) mass) | At least Small Building Level physically (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Stronger than before due to Brainiac enhancing his physical strength. Effortlessly stomped The Question, slapping him across a room and slamming him into a large wooden desk with enough force to split it in half. Easily kept up with and is implied to be stronger than Batman), far higher with Weaponry and Preparation (Should have access to the same arsenal as his base form) | Brown Dwarf Level (Scaling to [https://character-stats-and-profiles.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:Xanadude72/DC_Animated_Universe_(DCAU)_Upgrade_Calculations_(Part_1)#RECALCULATION::~:text=**3.4680853e%2B37%20Joules,I%20stand%20corrected.]1.002 Quettatons - His beam could beam struggle with Green Lantern, harm GL despite GL's energy aura being up, and harm Season 1 Superman. Though JL Season 1 Superman is plot nerfed (even in the opinion of Bruce Timm himself), he was still strong enough to take hits from the likes of Solomon Grundy and Star Sapphire and keep fighting, as well as completely no-sell blade attacks from Metamorpho that sliced apart Martian Manhunter) | Brown Dwarf Level with individual tentacles (Downscaling from [https://character-stats-and-profiles.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:Xanadude72/DC_Animated_Universe_(DCAU)_Upgrade_Calculations_(Part_1)#RECALCULATION::~:text=**3.4680853e%2B37%20Joules,I%20stand%20corrected.]1.002 Quettatons - His tentacles could harm and restrain Martian Manhunter, as well as Wonder Woman), far higher with multiple tentacles (Upscaling from 8.018 Quettatons - Put enough pressure on Green Lantern's shield to shatter it, though this did cause the tentacles performing this feat to be torn apart. Restrained Superman with a great plurality of tentacles, later being depicted as completely immobilizing him with tentacles after wearing him down - however, moments from the episode directly after this imply Superman's will is unsteady due to his fear of killing Luthor, which could affect the extent to which he allows himself to not hold back) | Brown Dwarf Level, possibly far higher (Upscaling from 8.018 Quettatons - Should be much stronger than his prior state, even with several tentacles. Essentially 1v7'd the Justice League until The Flash used his full power to defeat him. His beams could more-or-less oneshot Superman, Green Lantern, Martian Manhunter, Hawkgirl, and Wonder Woman, albeit Superman was arguably weakened at the time. With a fraction of his power, he created pseudo-clones of the League: though several of the clones, notably Flash's (who the genuine article blitzed) and Superman's, are weaker than the people they're meant to imitate, one of these clones could struggle with Martian Manhunter. While this could easily be untrue and simply Goldface being ignorant, Goldface references a fully fused "Lexiac" as "more powerful than (the Legion of Doom) put together" - with the Legion of Doom, at the time, containing Bizarro, Rampage, Sinestro, Volcana, Star Sapphire, Tala, and Giganta, among others. See here for my reasoning as to why DCAU Superman is not Low Complex Multiversal)

At least Peak Human combat speed (Only tagged Batman when Batman was holding on to him, but otherwise appears to be a capable fighter, and is in excellent shape), likely higher (Reacted to and blocked an energy blast after it was fired), with Relativistic reactions (Reacted to a Lantern Beam coming toward him), up to Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c - His mech tagged Hawkgirl with a punch) or Speed of Light (The Lexo-skel uses black-light lasers, as mentioned above) Attack Speed with Preparation and Weaponry | Hypersonic to Relativistic+ or higher reactions and combat speed (His reactions should be at least as fast as before after Brainiac's enhancements. Caught a Batarang thrown by Batman and tagged him) | Relativistic+ reactions and combat speed (Scaling to 0.53c - Blocked mace strikes from Hawkgirl and, on another occasion, rushed her, grabbing her mace before she could complete a swing and tossing her aside. Dodged an object thrown by Wonder Woman) | At least Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c - Tagged Justice Leaguers) | At least FTL (Upscaling from Superman's speed of 2.3c - Was capable of reacting to The Flash's first planet-crossing punch, even putting his hands up to block it - with even the first of these punches seeming to be Wally going at his fastest ever up to that point, though Wally continued to increase in speed with each punch and eventually blitzed Luthor), with at least FTL attack speed with beams (Casually blitzed all the Leaguers, even Superman - Batman dodging one is an obvious outlier)

Small Building Level physically (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should be capable of enduring his own physical power), with his robots and equipment having varying durability (His robots should be able to take the force they exert. His massive mech shrugged off a hit from a bloodlusted Hawkgirl and a combined assault from Martian Manhunter and Superman. The Leko-Skel was unhurt by being shot by a tank. However, his other weapons, like his ships and the Lexwing, don't seem to be quite as durable) | At least Small Building Level physically (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Shrugged off two powerful strikes from a serious Batman. Should be capable of withstanding his own physical power), with his robots and equipment having varying durability (Explained above) | Brown Dwarf Level (Scaling to 1.002 Quettatons - Took his own beam shot back at him) | At least Small Building Level, likely far higher physically (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Took blows from Superman, though the entire CADMUS arc centers around Superman being deathly afraid of killing Luthor - as such, Superman was almost definitely holding back to an extreme degree), with his tentacles having Brown Dwarf Level durability (Scaling to 1.002 Quettatons - Green Lantern's individual blasts did no visible damage to them. Didn't budge no matter how much Wonder Woman and Martian Manhunter struggled, as described above, and it took Hawkgirl an indeterminate amount of time of hammering one with mace swings to break it), possibly higher (As described above, a great plurality of tentacles could restrain Superman - however, moments from the episode directly after this imply Superman's will is unsteady due to his fear of killing Luthor, which could affect the extent to which he allows himself to not hold back) | Brown Dwarf Level, possibly higher (Upscaling from 8.018 Quettatons - It's very strongly implied that The Flash wouldn't have been able to break through his armor if he hadn't gone faster than ever before)

In his base, he possesses Normal Human Weaknesses, has cancer, and in all of his forms is extremely egotistical. The Lexo-suit can seemingly be disabled with an electric shock to the back. Otherwise, none notable. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9 Category:Tier 5

Extraordinary Genius (Despite his violent and uncouth nature, Lobo possess a remarkable intellect in matters of destruction and violence. He can trace any prey across the universe, speak 17,897 different languages from across the galaxy, communicate in Morse code, and create complex virulent agents and the necessary antidotes to them such as the one he let loose on Czarnia, which resulted in the deaths of the entire population in one week. With his mechanical aptitude, Lobo was able to scavenge parts from a destroyed time hopper and attach them to his own bike, producing a working time machine, and he is capable of inventing and devising advanced technology, even reprogramming Apokoliptian technology to trick Darkseid. However, even with his genius-level intellect, Lobo is usually too drunk to use it properly)

Lobo is very arrogant and he can easily lose his patience. He takes delight in fighting and does not get along well in groups, whereas his comrades were often the target of his physical and verbal violence during his time in the L.E.G.I.O.N. He is usually drunk and not at 100% capability, and is also susceptible to manipulation from women. As an infallible man of his word, Lobo will never break a contract, even if it means his death. Banned from both hell and heaven, can live as a skeleton and can possess other beings as a spirit when his body is erased, turning their bodies into his own), Supernatural Willpower (Used his own willpower to break a force field created by G'nort), Duplication (Can create clones of himself from a single drop of his blood; Depending on which version), Extrasensory Perception (Capable of tracking anyone anywhere in the universe once he gets their scent), Self-Sustenance (Types 1, 2 and 3), Martial Arts, Non-Physical Interaction (Can touch intangible beings), Often demonstrates Toon Force-like abilities, Possession (He can become a spirit and possess other beings), Limited Biological Manipulation (When he possesses another living being as a spirit, the body transforms into Lobo's original form), 4th Wall Breaking (Has messed with the panelling and interacted with DC's creative team), Resistance to Telepathy, Diseases, Magic, and various other forms of attack
Varies, up to Galaxy level, likely Low Complex Multiverse level at his peak (Carried a sun with his chains. He traded blows with Superman, Despero, the Martian Manhunter, and Captain Marvel)
Massively FTL+ flight speed with his bike. Massively FTL+ reflexes/combat speed at his peak (Comparable to Superman)
Varies, up to Galaxy level, likely Low Complex Multiverse level at his peak (Regeneration and immortality make him extremely difficult to kill)
Superhuman
Thousands of Kilometers with some of his weapons, but prefers to fight at melee range.

A hook on a chain which is his primary weapon, it is made of an unknown material and can damage incredibly resilient targets, his bike, the SpazFrag 666, which can fly through space at Massively FTL speed, responds to his commands, is semi-sentient and will only let him ride it (although it will let him carry passengers if Lobo allows it), it is equipped with many weapons such as lasers, projectile launchers, particle beams, missiles, etc. Lobo often carries various high-tech weaponry along with him, such as various guns, bombs, and even a time machine

Extraordinary Genius (Despite his violent and uncouth nature, Lobo possess a remarkable intellect in matters of destruction and violence. He can trace any prey across the universe, speak 17,897 different languages from across the galaxy, communicate in Morse code, and create complex virulent agents and the necessary antidotes to them such as the one he let loose on Czarnia, which resulted in the deaths of the entire population in one week. With his mechanical aptitude, Lobo was able to scavenge parts from a destroyed time hopper and attach them to his own bike, producing a working time machine, and he is capable of inventing and devising advanced technology, even reprogramming Apokoliptian technology to trick Darkseid. However, even with his genius-level intellect, Lobo is usually too drunk to use it properly)

Lobo is very arrogant and he can easily lose his patience. He takes delight in fighting and does not get along well in groups, whereas his comrades were often the target of his physical and verbal violence during his time in the L.E.G.I.O.N. He is usually drunk and not at 100% capability, and is also susceptible to manipulation from women. As an infallible man of his word, Lobo will never break a contract, even if it means his death. A hook on a chain which is his primary weapon, it is made of an unknown material and can damage incredibly resilient targets, his bike, the SpazFrag 666, which can fly through space at Massively FTL speed, responds to his commands, is semi-sentient and will only let him ride it (although it will let him carry passengers if Lobo allows it), it is equipped with many weapons such as lasers, projectile launchers, particle beams, missiles, etc. Lobo often carries various high-tech weaponry along with him, such as various guns, bombs, and even a time machine

Extraordinary Genius (Despite his violent and uncouth nature, Lobo possess a remarkable intellect in matters of destruction and violence. He can trace any prey across the universe, speak 17,897 different languages from across the galaxy, communicate in Morse code, and create complex virulent agents and the necessary antidotes to them such as the one he let loose on Czarnia, which resulted in the deaths of the entire population in one week. With his mechanical aptitude, Lobo was able to scavenge parts from a destroyed time hopper and attach them to his own bike, producing a working time machine, and he is capable of inventing and devising advanced technology, even reprogramming Apokoliptian technology to trick Darkseid. However, even with his genius-level intellect, Lobo is usually too drunk to use it properly)

Lobo is very arrogant and he can easily lose his patience. He takes delight in fighting and does not get along well in groups, whereas his comrades were often the target of his physical and verbal violence during his time in the L.E.G.I.O.N. He is usually drunk and not at 100% capability, and is also susceptible to manipulation from women. As an infallible man of his word, Lobo will never break a contract, even if it means his death.
